name: Vézelay, Church and Hill
description: Perched on a hilltop in Burgundy, in France's Yonne department, Vézelay is crowned by the Romanesque basilica of Sainte-Marie-Madeleine, built between 1120 and 1150. Its carved capitals and grand doorway are among the finest of the period. Pilgrims have come for centuries to see the relics of Mary Magdalene, and two crusades were launched from this spot.
